name: Limeira
registryCustodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Limeira, Secretaria de Urbanismo, Setor de Cadastro Imobiliário / Divisão de Georreferenciamento e Topografia
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Portuguese first-party discovery found Limeira Geo and the municipal cadastral custodian. Following the current GeoPixel JavaScript configuration reached public WMS/WFS capabilities. The lote_test schema and bounded EPSG:4326 GetFeature request returned three parcel polygons with native numeric id values; the public consultation form was not submitted.
scopeLimits: The three-feature bbox is a bounded sample, not a citywide parcel extract.
The exact WUP point [-22.5767195028358, -47.4091324198603] was preserved and not shifted; nearby sample geometry was not used as an exact-point hit or absence test.
The direct Limeira Geo entry page returned a Cloudflare 502/error response, but this is not evidence of citywide absence.
Public WFS access does not establish production adapter quality, update cadence, or complete coverage.
sourceSpecificFields: The source schema exposes native id, gid, codigo, and geom among many fields. The retained GeoJSON uses only canonical properties.id derived from native id; no raw source attribute set is retained.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission; the serial reviewer must independently verify route, field mapping, CRS handling, and safe identifier choice.
uncertainty: The municipal public route is geometry-verified for the bounded request, but citywide completeness and the viewer's normal application flow were not exhaustively tested. No credentials, private tokens, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were requested.
